format.actions: Quaternion transforms sampled every frame; analytic poses use smoothstep easing.

fictional_prop.right_index: extended along exterior; no trigger modeled
fictional_prop.door: visual-only hinge, no destructive geometry or gameplay event

shoulder_elbow_pose.method: Fixed body-relative outward/downward elbow pole; clavicle rotates forward at unchanged length. Whole prop reaches farther forward while its relative palm/finger transforms remain fixed.
shoulder_elbow_pose.old_failure: A pole chosen only to minimize palm/forearm angle moved patrol elbows nearly onto the sternum and pulled the upper sleeve through the torso.
shoulder_elbow_pose.separate_mesh_gate: Validation/arm_body_clearance.json records independently measured evaluated sleeve/torso clearance when available; joint angles alone do not prove mesh clearance.
